scripts.android:run: export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}" && export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH" && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 >/dev/null 2>&1; adb shell monkey -p com.puzint.wordwheel.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; npx expo start
scripts.android:build: export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}" && export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH" && npx expo run:android
scripts.android:run:release: export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}" && export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH" && npx expo run:android --variant release
scripts.android:sync: npx expo prebuild --platform android && npm run android:run
scripts.android:studio: CI=1 npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && open -a 'Android Studio' "$PWD/android"
scripts.clean: rm -rf android/app/build android/build node_modules/.cache .expo dist web-build
scripts.metadata:upload: unset BUNDLE_GEMFILE; bundle exec fastlane metadata
scripts.screenshots: npx playwright install chromium && node docs/scripts/capture-screenshots.js
scripts.screenshots:upload: npm run screenshots && npm run metadata:upload
